title: Angela K NDE 166
content: When I was just three years old I drowned in a pool behind my house. When my mother found me, I was floating face down in the water. My father who said that a voice told him to hold me upside down to get the water out resuscitated me. This worked and I began to breathe again. I spent a little time at a hospital and later told my father of the events. I first told him that I wanted to go to the church, the church that was being built. I said it wasn't finished yet. After questioning me some more, I told him that two angels held my arms and took me up into the sky. I told him that there were people building a church out of gold bricks and that they were waving at me. I turned and saw two thrones with two beings sitting in them. Their faces were clouded but one of them told me that 'it wasn't my time yet'. I insisted that I wanted to stay and he told me that I had to go back to my mom and dad. Then I told him that I saw a little girl (which was me) and then it was over. I apparently went back into my body. I remember all of these details to this day.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident drowning Life threatening event, but not clinical death Fell into pool while unattended and drowned.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I was in a completely different dimension.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Heaven seemed to be without sound and full of emotion. The only voice I heard was that of God or Jesus.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes The men and women building the church who waved to me.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Unbelievably bright warm yellow light.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Explained above.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I felt that I was in the company of kindness that I did not want to leave, even if it meant leaving my parents.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told by God or Jesus that I had to go back to my parents, I had no choice in the matter regardless of my protest.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told by God or Jesus that I had to go back to my parents, I had no choice in the matter regardless of my protest. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I knew that there was a heaven because I had seen it with my own eyes. I have a strong belief in God.
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Dreams that come true the next day and knowing information about strangers.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was that I had the experience of meeting God and Jesus but the worst part of it was that my mother suffered emotional trauma because she felt responsible for my drowning.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes There was a general feeling of disbelief when I was younger yet when I got a little older people were amazed and believed in me.
